A hardware-accelerated QML item that draws error bars: a line from a low to a high bound at each data point, capped at both ends.

detaileddescription.para: Each data point is an (x, y, low, high) quadruple. orientation selects the axis that low and high lie on: a vertical error bar is drawn at x from low to high along the Y axis, and a horizontal one at y from low to high along the X axis. The other coordinate, y for vertical and x for horizontal error bars, is the value the bounds belong to. The series does not draw it: draw the values with a PointCloud or LineCurve declared after the error bars, so that its markers are drawn and hovered on top. The same xs and ys then feed both series.
setErrorData() and appendErrorData() take errors relative to the value instead of bounds, one for both sides or one per side, and store the bounds they give. A NaN error gives a NaN bound.

Data points are uploaded to the GPU as a float data texture once per data change; panning, zooming, and changing lineWidth, capLength, or offset only change shader uniforms. The setData() overloads keep doubles and upload them relative to an origin near the viewport, so large coordinates such as epoch timestamps stay precise. The setDataF() overloads store floats and upload them without conversion.

simplesect.title: Invalid data points
simplesect.para: A data point is not drawn or hovered when its position (x for vertical, y for horizontal error bars) is NaN or ±Inf, or not strictly positive on a log-scale axis, or when its value is NaN. A NaN bound leaves out that half of the error bar, which then runs from the value to the other bound. An infinite bound, and a bound that is not strictly positive on a log-scale axis, extends the error bar past the plot edge without a cap. low may be above high. Auto-ranging counts every valid coordinate on its own.

simplesect.title: Hover
simplesect.para: hoveredIndex is the error bar within hoverRadius pixels of the cursor, the nearest one when several are, and the one with the highest index on a tie. hoverColor draws it. Only the topmost series under the cursor is hovered: set hoverEnabled to false to leave hover to the series beneath.

simplesect.title: Transitions
simplesect.para: Assign a MorphTransition or DrawTransition to transition to animate data updates. With MorphTransition, error bars move to their new position, value, and bounds. New error bars appear, and removed ones disappear, at once. count, errorBarAt(), the data ranges, and inspection use the new data from the start of the animation, while hover picks the error bars as drawn. While a transition is enabled, the setDataF() overloads store doubles. appendData(), appendErrorData(), clearData(), and replacing, clearing, or cancelling transition, skip to the new data.

simplesect.title: Limits
simplesect.para:
At most 16,777,216 (2^24) error bars are drawn, fewer on GPUs whose maximum texture size is below
Error bars beyond the limit are not drawn or hovered, and a warning is logged once.
